question: If x + y + z = 0, then find the value of {{x²}over {x²-yz} }+{{y²} over {y²-zx}}+{{z²} over {z²-xy}}.
solution:
**Concept used:**

x² + y² + z² = (x + y + z)² - 2(xy + yz + zx)

**Calculations:**

According to the question, x + y + z = 0

x = - (y + z)

y = - (x + z)

z = - (x + y)

Now,

 {{x²}over {x²-yz} }+{{y²} over {y²-zx}}+{{z²} over {z²-xy}}

⇒ (x²)/(- x(y + z) - yz) + (y²)/(- y(x + z) - xz) + (z²)/(- z(x + y) - xy)

⇒ - (x²)/(xy + yz + zx) - (y²)/(xy + yz + zx) - (z²)/(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ - (x²+y²+z²)/(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ - {((x+y+z)²-2(xy + yz + zx))/(xy + yz + zx)} 

Substitute x + y + z = 0 in the above equation

⇒ (2(xy + yz + zx))/(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ 2

**Hence, the required value is 2.**
